text: Cam (PM): quick thread customers keep missing the perf badge in the catalog. also a rep said pinning a version sometimes seems to drop facet filters which surprises them. want to align on placement + pin-copy before prototype. Rae (Design): two simple options for prototype: (1) badge next to model name (large, 16px) with sr-only text; (2) tiny badge next to p99 so it's contextual. i'll mock both and a microtext variant that shows "fast/balanced/slow" when space allows. Ish (Frontend): (1) is the least risky with our virtualized list. (2) requires moving DOM cells which impacts virtualization sticky heuristics but doable behind a flag. performance note: rendering icons for thousands of rows costs CPU; use CSS sprite or font-icon. Marta (A11y): accessibility needs: badge must not rely on color. include an accessible label like aria-label="Performance: fast" and an sr-only word. if microtext is shown, ensure contrast >= 4.5:1. any chevron/expand controls must expose aria-expanded and aria-controls. Sam (Sales): customers preferred badge-by-p99 in a recent call because it's next to the metric they care about. also asked for a small delta indicator (eg "+3%") inline with p99 to show perf vs baseline. keep it subtle. Rae (Design): delta idea good: tiny chip with +- and percent on hover. for compact rows idea: show latency + p99 inline; delta appears only for p99. I'll add copy: tooltip "vs baseline" and sr-only description for the chip. Ish (Frontend): implementation sketch: ```html fast 18ms +3% ``` And localStorage key for pin filters: `ri:filters:{userId}:{modelId}:{versionId}` with 90-day TTL. if saved filters reference removed facets, ignore them and show a toast: "One saved filter is no longer available." Marta (A11y): for the delta chip make sure screen readers get a full phrase not just "+3%"; use aria-label="performance delta plus three percent vs baseline" or similar. also announce filter-restore: aria-live text "Filters restored for pinned version v1.2". Cam (PM): decision for prototype: ship badge next to name for first pass (lower risk), include sr-only label and microtext behind flag; implement client-side opt-in "Remember filters with pin" in pin modal. Rae to mock, Ish to prototype behind flag, Marta + QA to run quick a11y checks. Rae (Design): i'll upload mocks for (name-badge + microtext) and (badge-by-p99) with delta chip copy. will annotate contrast tokens. Ish (Frontend): i'll put prototype behind feature flag, lazy-render expanded metric content, respect prefers-reduced-motion, wire up localStorage-based pin remember toggle, and add toast for stale filters. will open PR and link here. ci-bot: CI started for branch feat/catalog-badges-pin-filters by ish. Marta (A11y): quick checklist before merge: badge has aria-label and sr-only text, delta chip aria-labels, filter-restore aria-live, contrast >=4.5, keyboard focus order preserved. i'll review PR once opened. Sam (Sales): thanks all. once in dev we'll run a short session with a couple of power users to validate discoverability. Cam (PM): great; target dev deploy next week. thanks everyone. :rocket:
